import { fieldLabelCls, ServerErrorPanel, type RoleOption } from '@/components/users/DirectCreateUserDialog';
import { Loader2, Shield } from 'lucide-react';

interface ChangeRoleDialogProps {
    isOpen: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    /** The row this dialog acts on (null while closed). */
    user: { id: string; name?: string | null; role?: string | null } | null;
    /** All assignable roles, labels from the page's ROLE_META. */
    roleOptions: RoleOption[];
}

export const ChangeRoleDialog = ({ isOpen, onClose, user, roleOptions }: ChangeRoleDialogProps) => {
    const { toast } = useToast();
    const queryClient = useQueryClient();

    const currentRole = String(user?.role || '');
    const [role, setRole] = useState<string>(currentRole);
    const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!isOpen) return;
        setRole(String(user?.role || ''));
        setServerError(null);
    }, [isOpen, user]);

    const changeRoleMutation = useMutation({
        mutationFn: async () => {
            if (!user) return null;
            const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('manage-users', {
                body: { action: 'update', userId: user.id, userData: { role } },
            });
            if (error) throw new Error(await edgeFnErrorMessage(error, data));
            return data;
        },
        onSuccess: () => {
            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['users'] });
            toast({ title: 'Rôle mis à jour', description: `${user?.name || 'Cet utilisateur'} est désormais ${labelFor(roleOptions, role)}.` });
            onClose();
        },
        onError: (e: any) => setServerError(e?.message || 'Changement de rôle impossible.'),
    });

    const busy = changeRoleMutation.isPending;
    const unchanged = !role || role === currentRole;

    const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setServerError(null);
        if (unchanged) return;
        changeRoleMutation.mutate();
    };

    return (
        <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={(open) => { if (!open && !busy) onClose(); }}>
            <DialogContent className="max-w-md p-0 border border-ant-line bg-ant-paper rounded-2xl shadow-[0_24px_80px_-24px_rgba(20,20,19,0.28)] overflow-hidden">
                <form onSubmit={submit}>
                    <DialogHeader className="px-6 pt-6 pb-4 border-b border-ant-line space-y-1.5">
                        <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.28em] text-ant-mid">
                            <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-ant-orange" />
                            Autorisation
                        </div>
                        <DialogTitle className="font-display text-[20px] leading-tight tracking-tight text-ant-ink">
                            Changer le rôle
                        </DialogTitle>
                        <DialogDescription className="font-serif italic text-[13px] text-ant-mid">
                            <span className="not-italic font-semibold text-ant-ink">&ldquo;{user?.name}&rdquo;</span> — le nouveau rôle s&rsquo;applique dès la confirmation.
                        </DialogDescription>
                    </DialogHeader>

                    <div className="px-6 py-5 space-y-4">
                        <div className="space-y-1.5">
                            <span className={fieldLabelCls}>Rôle actuel</span>
                            <div>
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-ant-line bg-ant-light px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-ant-ink">
                                    <Shield className="w-3 h-3 text-ant-mid" />
                                    {labelFor(roleOptions, currentRole)}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-1.5">
                            <label className={fieldLabelCls}>Nouveau rôle</label>
                            <Select value={role} onValueChange={setRole} disabled={busy}>
                                <SelectTrigger className="h-10 rounded-xl border-ant-line bg-ant-paper text-[12px] text-ant-ink focus:ring-1 focus:ring-ant-orange/40">
                                    <SelectValue placeholder="Choisir un rôle" />
                                </SelectTrigger>
                                <SelectContent className="rounded-xl border-ant-line bg-ant-paper">
                                    {roleOptions.map((r) => (
                                        <SelectItem key={r.value} value={r.value} className="text-[12px]">
                                            {r.label}
                                        </SelectItem>
                                    ))}
                                </SelectContent>
                            </Select>
                        </div>

                        {serverError && <ServerErrorPanel message={serverError} />}
                    </div>

                    <DialogFooter className="px-6 py-4 border-t border-ant-line gap-2">
                        <Button
                            type="button"
                            variant="ghost"
                            onClick={onClose}
                            disabled={busy}
                            className="h-10 px-5 rounded-full text-[12px] font-semibold text-ant-mid hover:text-ant-ink hover:bg-ant-light cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none"
                        >
                            Annuler
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                            type="submit"
                            disabled={busy || unchanged}
                            className="h-10 px-5 rounded-full bg-ant-ink hover:bg-ant-ink/90 text-white text-[12px] font-semibold gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none"
                        >
                            {busy ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                            {busy ? 'Mise à jour…' : 'Confirmer le rôle'}
                        </Button>
                    </DialogFooter>
                </form>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
};

const labelFor = (options: RoleOption[], value: string) =>
    options.find((o) => o.value === value)?.label || value || '—';

export const fieldInputCls =
    'h-10 rounded-xl border-ant-line bg-ant-paper text-[12px] text-ant-ink placeholder:text-ant-mid focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ant-orange/40';
export const fieldLabelCls = 'text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-ant-mid';

/** Strong random password — crypto RNG, no dependency. */
export const generateStrongPassword = (length = 16): string => {
    // Ambiguous glyphs (0/O, 1/l/I) removed so a typed hand-off can't be misread.
    const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz23456789!@#$%&*?';
    const buf = new Uint32Array(length);
    crypto.getRandomValues(buf);
    return Array.from(buf, (n) => alphabet[n % alphabet.length]).join('');
};

/** Password input + show/hide, « Générer » and copy affordances. Shared with SetPasswordDialog. */
export const PasswordField = ({
    value,
    onChange,
    placeholder = '••••••••',
    withGenerate = true,
    disabled,
}: {
    value: string;
    onChange: (v: string) => void;
    placeholder?: string;
    withGenerate?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
}) => {
    const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
    const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!copied) return;
        const t = window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
        return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
    }, [copied]);

    const copy = async () => {
        if (!value) return;
        try {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
            setCopied(true);
        } catch {
            // Clipboard denied — the value is visible via the show toggle.
        }
    };

    return (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0">
                <Input
                    type={show ? 'text' : 'password'}
                    value={value}
                    disabled={disabled}
                    onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={placeholder}
                    autoComplete="new-password"
                    className={cn(fieldInputCls, 'pr-9 font-mono')}
                />
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShow((s) => !s)}
                    aria-label={show ? 'Masquer le mot de passe' : 'Afficher le mot de passe'}
                    className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-ant-mid hover:text-ant-ink transition-colors duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none cursor-pointer"
                >
                    {show ? <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                </button>
            </div>
            {withGenerate && (
                <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="ghost"
                    disabled={disabled}
                    onClick={() => { onChange(generateStrongPassword()); setShow(true); }}
                    className="h-10 px-3.5 rounded-xl border border-ant-line text-[11px] font-semibold text-ant-ink hover:bg-ant-light gap-1.5 shrink-0 cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none"
                >
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-ant-orange" />
                    Générer
                </Button>
            )}
            <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={copy}
                disabled={disabled || !value}
                aria-label="Copier le mot de passe"
                className={cn(
                    'h-10 w-10 p-0 rounded-xl border border-ant-line shrink-0 cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none disabled:opacity-40',
                    copied ? 'text-ant-green' : 'text-ant-mid hover:text-ant-ink hover:bg-ant-light',
                )}
            >
                {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
            </Button>
        </div>
    );
};

        <p className="text-[11.5px] font-medium text-ant-rose leading-snug">{message}</p>
    </div>
);

export const DirectCreateUserDialog = ({ isOpen, onClose, roleOptions }: DirectCreateUserDialogProps) => {
    const { toast } = useToast();
    const queryClient = useQueryClient();

    const [name, setName] = useState('');
    const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
    const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
    const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
    const [role, setRole] = useState<string>('commercial');
    const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
    const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!isOpen) return;
        setName(''); setUsername(''); setEmail(''); setPassword('');
        setRole(roleOptions.some((r) => r.value === 'commercial') ? 'commercial' : (roleOptions[0]?.value ?? 'commercial'));
        setErrors({}); setServerError(null);
    }, [isOpen, roleOptions]);

    const createMutation = useMutation({
        mutationFn: async () => {
            // Business scoping is server-side: manage-users stamps the caller's own business.
            const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('manage-users', {
                body: {
                    action: 'create',
                    userData: {
                        email: email.trim().toLowerCase(),
                        password,
                        name: name.trim(),
                        username: username.trim(),
                        role,
                    },
                },
            });
            if (error) throw new Error(await edgeFnErrorMessage(error, data));
            return data;
        },
        onSuccess: () => {
            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['users'] });
            toast({
                title: 'Utilisateur créé — identifiants actifs immédiatement',
                description: `${email.trim().toLowerCase()} peut se connecter dès maintenant.`,
            });
            onClose();
        },
        onError: (e: any) => setServerError(e?.message || 'Création impossible.'),
    });

    const validate = () => {
        const next: Record<string, string> = {};
        if (!name.trim()) next.name = 'Le nom est requis.';
        if (!username.trim()) next.username = "Le nom d'utilisateur est requis.";
        if (!email.trim()) next.email = "L'email est requis.";
        else if (!EMAIL_RE.test(email.trim())) next.email = "Format d'email invalide.";
        if (!password) next.password = 'Le mot de passe est requis.';
        else if (password.length < 8) next.password = 'Au moins 8 caractères.';
        if (!role) next.role = 'Le rôle est requis.';
        setErrors(next);
        return Object.keys(next).length === 0;
    };

    const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setServerError(null);
        if (!validate()) return;
        createMutation.mutate();
    };

    const busy = createMutation.isPending;
    const errCls = 'text-[11px] font-medium text-ant-rose';

        <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={(open) => { if (!open && !busy) onClose(); }}>

                            <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-ant-orange" />
                            Création directe
                        </div>
                        <DialogTitle className="font-display text-[20px] leading-tight tracking-tight text-ant-ink">
                            Créer un utilisateur
                        </DialogTitle>
                        <DialogDescription className="font-serif italic text-[13px] text-ant-mid">
                            Vous choisissez l&rsquo;identité et le mot de passe. Le compte est actif immédiatement, sans confirmation par email.
                        </DialogDescription>
                    </DialogHeader>

                    <div className="ant-scroll flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto px-6 py-5 space-y-5">
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">

                                    placeholder="Ex. Yassine Alami"
                                    className={fieldInputCls}
                                    disabled={busy}

                            </div>
                            <div className="space-y-1.5">
                                <label className={fieldLabelCls}>Nom d&rsquo;utilisateur</label>
                                <Input

-- TKT-10 backfill: each existing business's EARLIEST super admin becomes its
-- business owner. Rule + the exact 7-user list previewed to and approved by
-- the owner 2026-07-29 (Bellora Bio, El Moda, Golden Design, moulay soltan,
-- Orelle, Ouzlim Bio, test env). Runs AFTER 20260729150000 (trigger + unique
-- index exist; the trigger only guards demotion/deletion, not promotion, and
-- the partial unique index enforces one owner per business).

BEGIN;
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s';

UPDATE public.users u
SET role = 'business owner'
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (u2."DigiCom Business") u2.id
    FROM public.users u2
    WHERE u2.role = 'super admin' AND u2."DigiCom Business" IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY u2."DigiCom Business", u2.created_at ASC
) first_admin
WHERE u.id = first_admin.id;

COMMIT;

-- Security remediation 2026-07-03 (self-owned self-hosted production box).
-- Enforces column/row/tenant authorization controls surfaced by the internal
-- secure-coding review. All changes are non-destructive to data.
--
-- Design note on the guard triggers (R2/R5/R6): they are SECURITY INVOKER so
-- that current_user reflects the ACTUAL executing role. This lets them exempt
-- non-end-user writers cleanly:
--   * service_role  -> manage-users / provider webhooks / admin edge flows
--   * postgres      -> SECURITY DEFINER fns (sync_imported_orders, approve_sheet_order)
--   * cron          -> scheduled jobs
-- Only a real `authenticated` self-write is gated. (A SECURITY DEFINER trigger
-- would see current_user='postgres' and auth.uid()=NULL for service_role, which
-- would WRONGLY block legitimate admin edits made through manage-users.)

BEGIN;

-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- Shared helper: is the acting user a business admin?
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_is_business_admin()
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.users u
    WHERE u.id = auth.uid() AND u.role IN ('super admin','admin')
  );
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.current_user_is_business_admin() FROM public;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_user_is_business_admin() TO authenticated;

-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- R2 — users: column-level UPDATE grant + privileged-column guard
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
REVOKE UPDATE ON public.users FROM authenticated;
GRANT UPDATE (
  name, username, phone, address,
  avatar_url, avatar_config,
  bank_name, bank_account_holder, bank_rib, cin_number,
  courier_parcel_fragile, courier_parcel_open, courier_parcel_try_on,
  updated_at
) ON public.users TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_users_self_privileged_cols()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Exempt non-end-user writers (see header). Only gate real self-edits.
  IF current_user <> 'authenticated' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF public.current_user_is_business_admin() THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

  IF ( NEW.role              IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.role
    OR NEW."DigiCom Business" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."DigiCom Business"
    OR NEW.permissions       IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.permissions
    OR NEW.commission_price  IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.commission_price
    OR NEW.commission_basis  IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.commission_basis
    OR NEW.salary_amount     IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.salary_amount
    OR NEW.payment_type      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payment_type
    OR NEW.active            IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.active ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'privileged column change not permitted on self-update'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_guard_users_self_privileged_cols ON public.users;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_users_self_privileged_cols
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.users FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.guard_users_self_privileged_cols();

-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- R4 — courier payout notes: split tenant-read from admin-only write
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS courier_payment_notes_tenant_all ON public.courier_payment_notes;
CREATE POLICY courier_payment_notes_tenant_select ON public.courier_payment_notes
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING ("DigiCom Business" = (SELECT current_user_digicom_business_id()));
CREATE POLICY courier_payment_notes_admin_write ON public.courier_payment_notes
  FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING     ("DigiCom Business" = (SELECT current_user_digicom_business_id())
             AND (SELECT check_user_role(auth.uid(), ARRAY['super admin','admin'])))
  WITH CHECK ("DigiCom Business" = (SELECT current_user_digicom_business_id())
             AND (SELECT check_user_role(auth.uid(), ARRAY['super admin','admin'])));

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS courier_payment_note_orders_tenant_all ON public.courier_payment_note_orders;
CREATE POLICY courier_payment_note_orders_tenant_select ON public.courier_payment_note_orders
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING ("DigiCom Business" = (SELECT current_user_digicom_business_id()));
CREATE POLICY courier_payment_note_orders_admin_write ON public.courier_payment_note_orders
  FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING     ("DigiCom Business" = (SELECT current_user_digicom_business_id())
             AND (SELECT check_user_role(auth.uid(), ARRAY['super admin','admin'])))
  WITH CHECK ("DigiCom Business" = (SELECT current_user_digicom_business_id())

     1	-- TKT-10b: business-owner multiplicity (owner decision 2026-07-29).
     2	-- A business may now have SEVERAL business owners; business owners manage the
     3	-- role within their OWN business (create/promote/demote/delete peers). The
     4	-- platform owner can do anything. New safety rule: a business can never lose
     5	-- its LAST business owner (self-demotion or peer removal of the final one is
     6	-- blocked; platform owner overrides).
     7	-- The users_business_owner_needs_business CHECK stays. Apply as supabase_admin
     8	-- if postgres hits fn-ownership errors (see business-owner-role memory trap).
     9	
    10	BEGIN;
    11	SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s';
    12	
    13	DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.users_one_business_owner_per_biz;
    14	
    15	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_business_owner_role()
    16	RETURNS trigger
    17	LANGUAGE plpgsql
    18	SECURITY DEFINER
    19	SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
    20	AS $$
    21	DECLARE
    22	    v_actor_role text;
    23	    v_actor_biz uuid;
    24	    v_demote_or_delete boolean;
    25	    v_become_owner boolean;
    26	BEGIN
    27	    IF TG_RELID <> 'public.users'::regclass THEN
    28	        RAISE EXCEPTION 'protect_business_owner_role: unexpected relation %', TG_RELID;
    29	    END IF;
    30	
    31	    v_demote_or_delete :=
    32	        (TG_OP = 'DELETE' AND OLD.role = 'business owner')
    33	        OR (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.role = 'business owner' AND NEW.role IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.role);
    34	    v_become_owner :=
    35	        TG_OP IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') AND NEW.role = 'business owner'
    36	        AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR OLD.role IS DISTINCT FROM 'business owner');
    37	
    38	    -- Fast path: the vast majority of users writes touch neither guard.
    39	    IF NOT (v_demote_or_delete OR v_become_owner) THEN
    40	        RETURN CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN OLD ELSE NEW END;
    41	    END IF;
    42	
    43	    -- System/service-role sessions pass (edge fns enforce their own caller
    44	    -- checks; migrations/backfills run as postgres/supabase_admin).
    45	    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    46	        RETURN CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN OLD ELSE NEW END;
    47	    END IF;
    48	
    49	    SELECT role::text, "DigiCom Business" INTO v_actor_role, v_actor_biz
    50	    FROM public.users WHERE id = auth.uid();
    51	
    52	    -- Platform owner: unrestricted (including removing a last business owner).
    53	    IF v_actor_role = 'owner' THEN
    54	        RETURN CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN OLD ELSE NEW END;
    55	    END IF;
    56	
    57	    -- Peer management: only a business owner OF THE SAME BUSINESS as the target.
    58	    IF v_demote_or_delete AND (v_actor_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'business owner'
    59	        OR v_actor_biz IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."DigiCom Business") THEN
    60	        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Le propriétaire de l''entreprise ne peut pas être modifié par un pair.';
    61	    END IF;
    62	    IF v_become_owner AND (v_actor_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'business owner'
    63	        OR v_actor_biz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."DigiCom Business") THEN
    64	        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Seul un propriétaire de l''entreprise ou la plateforme peut désigner un propriétaire.';
    65	    END IF;
    66	
    67	    -- A business must keep at least one business owner.
    68	    IF v_demote_or_delete AND NOT EXISTS (
    69	        SELECT 1 FROM public.users u2
    70	        WHERE u2."DigiCom Business" = OLD."DigiCom Business"
    71	          AND u2.role = 'business owner'
    72	          AND u2.id <> OLD.id
    73	    ) THEN
    74	        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Impossible de retirer le dernier propriétaire de l''entreprise.';
    75	    END IF;
    76	
    77	    RETURN CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN OLD ELSE NEW END;
    78	END;
    79	$$;
    80	
    81	REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.protect_business_owner_role() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
    82	
    83	COMMIT;

1. **Critical — a BO can promote a BO to platform `owner`.**  
   **Location:** [migration:31](</Users/ismailelqorchi/Desktop/iGrowFast/New Website/iGrowFast/supabase/migrations/20260729180000_business_owner_multiplicity.sql:31>)  
   **Scenario:** With two BOs in business A, one changes either BO from `business owner` to `owner`. The source-business check passes and the other BO satisfies `EXISTS`, granting unrestricted platform access. Current `manage-users` also accepts this destination role.  
   **Fix:** Reject every transition into or out of platform `owner` unless the actor is already platform owner; allow BO demotions only to an explicit tenant-role allowlist.

2. **Critical — BO business moves bypass every guard.**  
   **Location:** [migration:31](</Users/ismailelqorchi/Desktop/iGrowFast/New Website/iGrowFast/supabase/migrations/20260729180000_business_owner_multiplicity.sql:31>), [fast path:38](</Users/ismailelqorchi/Desktop/iGrowFast/New Website/iGrowFast/supabase/migrations/20260729180000_business_owner_multiplicity.sql:38>)  
   **Scenario:** `UPDATE users SET "DigiCom Business" = B WHERE role = 'business owner'` changes neither role, so both flags are false. It can remove A’s last BO and inject one into B. The CHECK accepts the non-null destination.  
   **Fix:** Treat a BO business change as both leaving `OLD` business and entering `NEW` business; validate source, destination, and last-BO protection separately.

3. **High — the last-BO test has a real READ COMMITTED race.**  
   **Location:** [migration:67](</Users/ismailelqorchi/Desktop/iGrowFast/New Website/iGrowFast/supabase/migrations/20260729180000_business_owner_multiplicity.sql:67>)  
   **Scenario:** Businesses with BOs A and B receive concurrent demotions/deletes of different rows. Each transaction sees the other committed BO, both pass, and both can commit, leaving zero. Different target-row locks do not serialize them.  
   **Fix:** Lock a stable per-business row with `FOR UPDATE`, then re-count after acquiring that lock; edge-function count preflights remain UX checks, not enforcement.

4. **High — `auth.uid() IS NULL` is broader than the platform-owner exception.**  
   **Location:** [migration:43](</Users/ismailelqorchi/Desktop/iGrowFast/New Website/iGrowFast/supabase/migrations/20260729180000_business_owner_multiplicity.sql:43>)  
   **Scenario:** All service-role writes and Auth deletion cascades bypass tenant checks and the last-BO invariant. Current `manage-users` performs these mutations with service role, including non-atomic counts and an unpinned destination business.  
   **Fix:** Route BO mutations through an authenticated `SECURITY DEFINER` RPC that preserves the real `auth.uid()`, serializes per business, and reserves an explicit override for platform-owner/maintenance operations.

Requested checks:

- Same-business BO create/promote/demote/delete logic otherwise works, including self-demotion when another BO exists.
- Cross-business and non-BO actors are blocked when `auth.uid()` is present, except for the business-move and platform-role holes above.
- `IS DISTINCT FROM` handles role NULLs correctly; missing actor rows fail closed.
- RLS visibility is safe when the function owner is `supabase_admin` because it bypasses RLS. A `postgres` owner is safe only if it owns `public.users` and `FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` is off; otherwise actor/count reads can disappear and legitimate BO operations become locked out.
- Replay is idempotent: `DROP INDEX IF EXISTS`, `CREATE OR REPLACE`, and repeated `REVOKE` are safe; transaction rollback restores the index if function replacement fails.
- `users_business_owner_needs_business` remains compatible and blocks NULL-business BOs. Dropping the unique index correctly enables multiplicity.
- No scalar/`.single()` lookup assuming one BO was found. Current notification queries use role arrays and roster/UI code handles multiple rows. The material companion-code defects are the service-role bypass, destination-business handling, platform-role escalation, and duplicate last-BO race.
